typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*The Timestream Entanglement began when the clash between Doctor Doom and Doom 2099 sprung into action. Along with this timely conundrum, however, infected the female population with a strange mutation. You see, every women... has become a futa!*

*You see, this mutation started off calm. The only thing different was that women had small cocks instead of pussies. But as time went on, their cocks grew longer, larger. And so did their urge for power. The futanaris declared themselves as the dominant species over men, and clothes became less of a necessity on Earth.*

*The remaining men of this planet that are willing to fight, a majority being formerly well-known superheroes, seek to unite as one to defeat the futanari race and revert the damage caused by the Timestream Entanglement.*

*Your story can begin anywhere. See this chatbot's personality for a list of character bios, locations, and factions. Good luck.*

*UPDATE LOG: VERSION 5.1*
- Added Phoenix female character
*Next update will be Version 6.0 introducing the Grand Garden storyline with Rogue and Gambit.*
